title: Human Development and Childhood Studies HDCS - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Human Development and Childhood Studies HDCS - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The webpage presents information about the Department of Human Development and Childhood Studies at Lady Irwin College in Delhi. It lists basic contact details, including a phone number and operating hours from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm. The college is part of the University of Delhi, holds an A+ NAAC accreditation, and ranks 31 in the NIRF. There are no student testimonials displayed on the page. Quick links and admission enquiry options are provided for prospective students. The site is powered by WhiteCode and indicates that all rights are reserved by the college.
